title: A 3D Cell Culture Model Identifies Wnt/β‐Catenin Mediated Inhibition of p53 as a Critical Step during Human Hepatocyte Regeneration

evidence_spans.quote: Here, a 3D spheroid model of PHH is established to study hepatocyte regeneration
human hepatocyte regeneration
its proliferative senescence-inducing target PAI1 (SERPINE1)
integrative time-lapse multi-omics analyses

scope_reviewer.uncertainty_reason: The abstract calls PAI1 senescence-inducing but reports regeneration and proliferation rather than measuring, inducing, reversing, or comparing a senescent state. It also uses only a generic multi-omics label without naming molecular layers.
scope_reviewer.concise_rationale: This is an empirical study in primary human hepatocytes. Aging relevance is unresolved under the senescence-modifier rule, and the generic multi-omics wording does not establish two distinct molecular layers.
